run_KappaRunner_calculate: run the KappaRunner calculate method to compute thermal conductivity for a list of atomic structures
create_KappaRunner_instance: create a KappaRunner instance with an ASE calculator and input atomic structures for thermal conductivity calculations
run_get_kappa103_data_list: run get_kappa103_data_list to load atomic structures from an extxyz file for kappa calculations
run_KappaRunner_write_results: run the KappaRunner write_results method to save thermal conductivity calculation results to a compressed JSON file
run_KappaRunner_save_state: run the KappaRunner save_state method to checkpoint the current calculation state to a specified location
